operating_point.definition: case triage REVIEW, route mule_review and priority >= 30

mom_persona.definition: client with >= 2 remittances to the same recipient (remit_top_recipient_count >= 2); 232 clients by our analysis of the CNB data

notes: ablation 'without_radar' is the isolated run (same pipeline without clusters)
naive_raw_sharing pools all raw data into ONE node with thresholds calibrated per bank; it is not a guaranteed upper bound
